name: nft-flush-table-second-table-drops
description: same table flush as nft-flush-table-only, with a second table still dropping
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept; }"
nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.5.5.2 drop
nft add chain inet g out "{ type filter hook output priority 10; policy accept; }"
nft add rule inet g out ip daddr 10.5.5.2 drop
